data.user_input:
sandbox-server에서 root로 현재 상태 확인해줘:
1) ls -lh /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/bin/oracle
2) ls /u01/app/oraInventory/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'oraInventory없음'
3) find /tmp -name 'OraInstall*' -o -name 'installActions*' 2>/dev/null | head -5
4) ls /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/cfgtoollogs/opatchauto/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'opatchauto없음'
5) find /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1 -maxdepth 1 -name '.*' 2>/dev/null
